name: Ivy McCord
source:
"I said terrible things to her... I said that when I'm with her, bad things happen all the time."

A senior high school student attending New Sieg Academia. Though she has excellent grades and is from a good family, she doesn't have many friends and is often absent from school lately. She's docile and reserved but has a strong will hidden within. She's a member of the photography club.
